Class BatchTask

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.concurrent.FutureTask<V>
      • javafx.concurrent.Task<BatchMetrics>
        • gui.BatchTask
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Runnable, java.util.concurrent.Future<BatchMetrics>, java.util.concurrent.RunnableFuture<BatchMetrics>, javafx.concurrent.Worker<BatchMetrics>, javafx.event.EventTarget

    final class BatchTask
extends javafx.concurrent.Task<BatchMetrics>
    Executes batch media processing or metadata extraction on a background thread.

    This task coordinates long-running batch operations while reporting progress and completion status to the registered user interface components without blocking the JavaFX Application Thread.

    Since:
    29 June 2026
    Version:
    1.3
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs

    • Method Detail

      • setOnFileScanned

        void setOnFileScanned(java.util.function.Consumer<java.lang.Integer> listener)
        Sets the listener to be notified while files are scanned.

        The listener receives the current count of scanned files, allowing the processing statistics view to be updated downstream while the scan is in progress.

        Parameters:
        listener - the listener to receive the current count of scanned files

      • setOnFileProcessed

        void setOnFileProcessed(java.util.function.Consumer<java.lang.Integer> listener)
        Sets the listener to be notified while files are processed.

        The listener receives the current count of processed files, allowing the processing statistics view to be updated downstream while the processing is in progress.

        Parameters:
        listener - the listener to receive the current count of processed files

      • setOnBatchSummaryListener

        void setOnBatchSummaryListener(java.util.function.Consumer<BatchProcessEvent> listener)
        Sets the listener to receive batch process events for updating file summary metrics.

        Batch process events received from the MediaBatchProcessor are forwarded to the registered listener as processing progresses.

        Parameters:
        listener - the listener to receive batch process event updates

      • setOnMetadataInspected

        void setOnMetadataInspected(java.util.function.Consumer<MetadataInspectionEvent> listener)
        Registers a listener to receive notifications generated during metadata inspection.

        The listener receives each MetadataInspectionEvent produced by the MetadataInspector and forwards it for display or further processing by GUI components.

        Parameters:
        listener - the listener to receive metadata inspection events

      • call

        protected BatchMetrics call()
                     throws java.lang.Exception
        Executes the batch operation on the background thread.

        When metadata inspection is selected, metadata is retrieved via MetadataInspector instead. Otherwise, a MediaBatchProcessor is created for execution. In both cases, progress is reported to associated JavaFX controls.

        Specified by:
        call in class javafx.concurrent.Task<BatchMetrics>
        Returns:
        the BatchMetrics produced by the associated operation
        Throws:
        java.lang.Exception - if an unrecoverable error occurs during processing
